discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed inflation as a solution to the horizon and flatness problems. Linde turned it into a workable theory with new and chaotic inflation. Mukhanov, working with Chibisov, showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations during inflation seed all cosmic structure, and he predicted a nearly scale-invariant spectrum that is slightly red-tilted. These were falsifiable predictions made decades before the data existed. WMAP and Planck have since confirmed them with high precision: a spatially flat universe, adiabatic and nearly Gaussian primordial perturbations, coherent acoustic peaks from super-horizon modes, and a spectral index n_s of about 0.965, a deviation from exact scale invariance measured at more than 8 sigma. The framework turned the question of the universe's initial conditions into quantitative, testable physics, linking quantum field theory with the largest observable scales. It is now the foundation of modern cosmology and of every current CMB and large-scale-structure programme.
